## Empowering a sustainable future for our planet

Agilent supports more than 285,000 laboratories across 110 countries—advancing scientific discovery
and innovation on a global scale.

The Agilent Foundation partners with organizations that advance STEM education, promote global
wellbeing, and build climate resilience.

Agilent is advancing science with purpose—embedding circular economy principles to drive sustainable
innovation and long-term impact.

Agilent is deepening its collaboration with My Green Lab as a top-tier Transformative Sponsor, while
expanding our portfolio of ACT-labeled products to support more sustainable science.

## Testing for Life

Our mission is to contribute to a safer and healthier world by providing our customers with
innovative and high-quality laboratory, research and advisory services.

[ Learn more ][223]
[lc-msms-4_169]

## H1 2026 results

Eurofins’ H1 2026 results were published on the 23rd of July.

[ Read more ][224]
[business-team-in-a-small-meeting-in-the-office_9000-x-6000-px]

## Find a laboratory

Whatever your testing needs, we have the right experts to help you — find a laboratory near you.

[ Explore locations ][225]
[The Eurofins laboratory in Nantes, France, featuring two modern buildings with large windows,
illuminated during twilight. The buildings are surrounded by a well-maintained lawn and a fence in

## Our World Needs You

Eurofins offers a career like no other – with rewards to match. Join us in our mission to improve
health and safety for millions of people.

[ Explore our jobs ][226]
[A woman leaning against a wall in an office corridor with her arms crossed. The woman is smiling
directly at the camera and is wearing a lanyard, blouse and blazer. ]

## Long-term growth

Eurofins is investing for the future. Since our IPO, we have been one of the fastest growing listed
European companies.

[ Learn more ][227]
[A digital screen displays a financial chart with fluctuating orange lines representing stock market
data. The background shows a cityscape at sunset, with skyscrapers and blurred lights, creating a
dynamic and modern atmosphere.]

Eurofins is a leading provider of analytical testing services. With a network of laboratories in 57
countries, we work across markets, continents and industries to carry out testing to improve health,
safety and the environment.

## Testing for Life

Our mission is to contribute to a safer and healthier world by providing our customers with
innovative and high-quality laboratory, research and advisory services.

[ Learn more ][223]
[lc-msms-4_169]

## H1 2026 results

Eurofins’ H1 2026 results were published on the 23rd of July.

[ Read more ][224]
[business-team-in-a-small-meeting-in-the-office_9000-x-6000-px]

## Find a laboratory

Whatever your testing needs, we have the right experts to help you — find a laboratory near you.

[ Explore locations ][225]
[The Eurofins laboratory in Nantes, France, featuring two modern buildings with large windows,
illuminated during twilight. The buildings are surrounded by a well-maintained lawn and a fence in
the foreground. The sky is partly cloudy, and several cars are parked near the buildings.]

## Our World Needs You

Eurofins offers a career like no other – with rewards to match. Join us in our mission to improve
health and safety for millions of people.

[ Explore our jobs ][226]
[A woman leaning against a wall in an office corridor with her arms crossed. The woman is smiling
directly at the camera and is wearing a lanyard, blouse and blazer. ]

## Long-term growth

Eurofins is investing for the future. Since our IPO, we have been one of the fastest growing listed
European companies.

[ Learn more ][227]
[A digital screen displays a financial chart with fluctuating orange lines representing stock market
data. The background shows a cityscape at sunset, with skyscrapers and blurred lights, creating a
dynamic and modern atmosphere.]

Eurofins is a leading provider of analytical testing services. With a network of laboratories in 57
countries, we work across markets, continents and industries to carry out testing to improve health,
safety and the environment.

## Insights & News


###### [PerkinElmer Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report, Advancing its Commitment to Cleaner
###### Science and a More Sustainable Future][246]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical and testing solutions and pharma specialty services,
serving the life sciences, applied and industrial, and food markets, today released its second
annual Sustainability Report, detailing the company's environmental, social, and governance
performance and progress in 2025.


###### [PerkinElmer and Covalent Announce Strategic Collaboration to Advance Failure Analysis and
###### Materials Characterization for Semiconductor, Electronics, and Battery Industries][247]

PerkinElmer and Covalent today announced a strategic collaboration to provide advanced analytical
instrumentation and analysis services that address the growing complexity of failure analysis and
materials characterization.


###### [PerkinElmer Partners with eXXpedition to Advance Ocean Science and a More Sustainable
###### Future][248]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical solutions that drive human and environmental health,
today announced a partnership with eXXpedition, the all-women global sailing research organization
dedicated to investigating the causes and impacts of plastic pollution in the marine environment.


###### [Project Farma Expands PMIS Offering with Oracle Primavera Cloud to Address Growing Pharma
###### Capital Project Complexity][249]

Project Farma, PerkinElmer’s patient-focused life sciences consulting firm dedicated to accelerating
manufacturing for life-changing therapies, today announced a partnership with Oracle Primavera Cloud
(OPC) to enhance its project controls and capital program delivery capabilities for pharmaceutical
and biotech organizations.

## Insights & News


###### [PerkinElmer Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report, Advancing its Commitment to Cleaner
###### Science and a More Sustainable Future][246]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical and testing solutions and pharma specialty services,
serving the life sciences, applied and industrial, and food markets, today released its second
annual Sustainability Report, detailing the company's environmental, social, and governance
performance and progress in 2025.


###### [PerkinElmer and Covalent Announce Strategic Collaboration to Advance Failure Analysis and
###### Materials Characterization for Semiconductor, Electronics, and Battery Industries][247]

PerkinElmer and Covalent today announced a strategic collaboration to provide advanced analytical
instrumentation and analysis services that address the growing complexity of failure analysis and
materials characterization.


###### [PerkinElmer Partners with eXXpedition to Advance Ocean Science and a More Sustainable
###### Future][248]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical solutions that drive human and environmental health,
today announced a partnership with eXXpedition, the all-women global sailing research organization
dedicated to investigating the causes and impacts of plastic pollution in the marine environment.


###### [Project Farma Expands PMIS Offering with Oracle Primavera Cloud to Address Growing Pharma
###### Capital Project Complexity][249]

Project Farma, PerkinElmer’s patient-focused life sciences consulting firm dedicated to accelerating
manufacturing for life-changing therapies, today announced a partnership with Oracle Primavera Cloud
(OPC) to enhance its project controls and capital program delivery capabilities for pharmaceutical
and biotech organizations.

## Harvest More With BranValt

At BranValt, we help you put more of your hard-earned yield where it belongs –in the bin, not on the
field. Reduce dockage, increase capacity, and boost your bottom line with harvest optimization tools
that can pay for themselves in the first field. **You can only harvest a crop once. Make it count.

Our Testimonials

## Hear What Our Customers Have to Say

## 5.0

Trusted by Thousands of Farmers Worldwide

“One thing we like about the drop pan is, it actually shows the quality of the grain and if we’re
throwing grain over. So, it gives us better judgement on how to set the combine. It tells you how
much you’re throwing over and then you start dealing with how you can improve that on your combine.
Everyone should know [their losses]. It’s beneficial to know or it’s profit that you could be just
throwing out the window.”

##### Blair Goethals, Manitoba Canada

SmartPan System

“Before using the BranValt MiniCombine, I would have just gone out there and threshed some grain by
hand or whatever. If I felt like it was anywhere close, I would just fire up a combine to see where
it tested. The MiniCombine is able to get a sample so I can see what it really is testing so I can
make a decision on whether to have a crew get ready to come out. I don’t have to fire up a combine.
I can take it to another field to check without moving a combine. Very handy.”

##### Mike Van Driesten (Van Driesten Harvesting), USA/CAN Custom Harvester

MiniCombine

“We’ve done a lot of testing with BranValt. Side by sides from with two different machines. One
running BranValt concaves and one with a competitor’s [concaves]. We dropped pans behind both
machines. We’ve seen definitely less losses, whether that’s the ground up FM (foreign material) or
loose grain. Anywhere from .5 bu/ac to 2 bu/ac. We can confidently say we’ve seen less loss behind
the combine with BranValt [MAD] Concaves.”

##### Chet Larson, Minnesota USA

MAD Concaves

“Besides saving money by not running around with the big combine taking samples… this unit saves us
from dealing with tough grain in combine hoppers after sampling.”

##### Chris Raupers, Manitoba Ca

Our Testimonials

## Hear What Our Customers Have to Say

## 5.0

Trusted by Thousands of Farmers Worldwide

“One thing we like about the drop pan is, it actually shows the quality of the grain and if we’re
throwing grain over. So, it gives us better judgement on how to set the combine. It tells you how
much you’re throwing over and then you start dealing with how you can improve that on your combine.
Everyone should know [their losses]. It’s beneficial to know or it’s profit that you could be just
throwing out the window.”

##### Blair Goethals, Manitoba Canada

SmartPan System

“Before using the BranValt MiniCombine, I would have just gone out there and threshed some grain by
hand or whatever. If I felt like it was anywhere close, I would just fire up a combine to see where
it tested. The MiniCombine is able to get a sample so I can see what it really is testing so I can
make a decision on whether to have a crew get ready to come out. I don’t have to fire up a combine.
I can take it to another field to check without moving a combine. Very handy.”

##### Mike Van Driesten (Van Driesten Harvesting), USA/CAN Custom Harvester

MiniCombine

“We’ve done a lot of testing with BranValt. Side by sides from with two different machines. One
running BranValt concaves and one with a competitor’s [concaves]. We dropped pans behind both
machines. We’ve seen definitely less losses, whether that’s the ground up FM (foreign material) or
loose grain. Anywhere from .5 bu/ac to 2 bu/ac. We can confidently say we’ve seen less loss behind
the combine with BranValt [MAD] Concaves.”

##### Chet Larson, Minnesota USA

MAD Concaves

“Besides saving money by not running around with the big combine taking samples… this unit saves us
from dealing with tough grain in combine hoppers after sampling.”

##### Chris Raupers, Manitoba Ca

##### FAQs

How do I register?

You can register on our website using the exact company name that is on your company's W-9 or
corporate return. Start off by verify your company's address, fill in appropriate boxes, then click
submit. Once you are you registered you can access the website features.

What if I forgot my username/password?

If you forget your username or password, click here, enter your email address and we will email you
your account information. If you forget your email address, please contact your sales
representative.

EquipNet has been revolutionizing the way companies manage their surplus assets for over two
decades. Our clients range in size from small businesses to Fortune 500 multi-national corporations.
We manage the entire sales and redeployment process, handling a single piece of equipment, or
managing your global investment and redeployment program, including plant closures.

## Buy Equipment

EquipNet is the largest online venue for pre-owned manufacturing, packaging, laboratory, test,
electronics, and facility support equipment. Shop 1,000+ equipment categories across 3 sales
channels.

[MarketPlace™][85]

[Auctions][86]

[Own It Now™][87]

## Sell Equipment

Whether it’s a site closure, a facility reorganization, or simply surplus equipment, EquipNet will
manage the sales process ensuring maximum cash value recovered.

[List an Item for Sale][88]

[List Multiple Items For Sale][89]

[Plant Closures & Projects][90]

## Manage Equipment

EquipNet’s proprietary technology (ARMS™), along with turnkey capabilities deliver a professionally
managed investment recovery and redeployment program.

[Global Programs][91]

[Regional Programs][92]

[Multiple Plant Programs][93]

## Integrated Laboratory Services

Asset Management, Compliance, Operations & Transitions

## Client Success Stories

### Biotech/Pharmaceutical Facility Closure: Massachusetts

One of our previous project clients recommended our services to Synta Pharmaceuticals to help with
closing a facility consisting of three different buildings. The entire facility needed full
clearance and contained an array of over 400 pieces of R&D equipment.
[Read More][105]

### The Success of Buying & Selling Equipment with EquipNet

EquipNet is constantly working on asset disposition projects with multiple clients across the globe
to help companies buy, sell, and manage their surplus. This case study outlines how EquipNet was
able to help our long-term client buying and selling. 
[Read More][106]

### Cookie Production Line: Colombia

This client originally sought out an auctioneer company to help sell a cookie production line from a
facility in Colombia. When the company was unsuccessful in its efforts, the auctioneer directly
reached out to EquipNet for expert assistance. 
[Read More][107]
[View More][108]

Be the first to know about new equipment, upcoming auctions, and other services that might be
beneficial to your needs. Register now and save time when you want to buy or sell equipment.

Flaman Agriculture has become the Western Canada leading supplier of farm machinery through our 11
locations in Alberta, Saskatchewan and Manitoba. Our team of over 30 expert farm sales team members

equipment that needs annual servicing.

grain bins, field discs, drag harrows, grain carts, seed tenders, sprayer trailers, rotary cutters,
ATV sprayers, snow blowers, finishing mowers, manure spreaders, grain vacs and water pumps. From
field prep to seeding, spraying & fertilizer, harvest and grain storage, we offer products to keep

# Flaman Farm and Agricultural Equipment for Sale

Flaman Agriculture has become the Western Canada leading supplier of farm machinery through our 11
locations in Alberta, Saskatchewan and Manitoba. Our team of over 30 expert farm sales team members
have well over 100 years of combined experience in the Ag industry. Beyond the initial sale, we
continue to support you with a parts department and service shop to fully service your needs,
whether it's an equipment transport trailer that needs new axles or a specific part of farm
equipment that needs annual servicing.

Each Flaman Agriculture location carries a wide assortment of farm implements and farm equipment to
meet the needs of local farmers. Some of our most popular types of equipment include grain augers,
grain bins, field discs, drag harrows, grain carts, seed tenders, sprayer trailers, rotary cutters,
ATV sprayers, snow blowers, finishing mowers, manure spreaders, grain vacs and water pumps. From
field prep to seeding, spraying & fertilizer, harvest and grain storage, we offer products to keep
your farming operation on the go.

# 
# BALANCE WHAT MATTERS

### The agri-food industry has a growing focus on striking the balance between increasing yields,
### health, and growth of animals and crops with a drive towards resource efficiency and sustainable
### food production.
### 
### We provide analytics beyond measure, enabling businesses to run intelligent data-driven
### productions with less waste and bigger yields.


## Find a Solution

### We provide more than 60 solutions within food and agricultural analysis. Find one to suit your
### needs

Product/Sample/Parameter
Industry Dairy Feed and Forage Grain and Oilseed Laboratories Meat More industries Raw Milk Testing
Wine and Beer
Technology Digestion Digital services Distillation Falling number Fibre analysis Flow Cytometry FTIR
Hydrolysis Image analysis NIR Sample preparation Solvent extraction X-ray image analysis
Find a Solution

## We've got you covered

### The global network of FOSS offices, specialists and service staff keep your operation running at
### peak performance. Anywhere, anytime.

[Read more][93]

## Join us

### As a FOSS employee you will be working in a professional and dynamic environment where sustained
### business growth is the primary focus.

[Read more][94]

Preţul spot al ţiţeiului Brent (Europa), evoluţia cotaţiilor internaţionale ale petrolului, date şi

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[Societate »][67]
[Măslinii, frasinii și platanii pot răci orașele cu 3,5°C][68]
Cercetătorii au identificat cinci specii de arbori care pot reduce temperaturile urbane cu până la
3,5°C, subliniind potențialul lor de a reduce stresul termic și de a îmbunătăți rezistența la
schimbările climatice în orașe. [»][69]
[Ştiinţă »][70]
[Cristalele de zahăr detectează materia întunecată][71]
Cercetătorii dintr-o colaborare internațională au propus un instrument neobișnuit pentru căutarea
materiei întunecate: cristalele de zahăr. [»][72]
[Tehnologie »][73]
[O nouă descoperire în domeniul electroliților crește performanța bateriilor][74]
Cercetătorii de la Laboratorul Național Oak Ridge, din Statele Unite, au dezvoltat un nou tip de
electrolit polimeric care ar putea îmbunătăți semnificativ performanța bateriilor în stare solidă și
a altor tehnologii energetice, permițând un transport de ioni dramatic mai rapid. [»][75]
[Inteligență artificială »][76]
[Software de recunoaștere a vehiculelor pentru semnalarea comportamentului neobișnuit în trafic][77]
Cercetătorii de la Laboratorul Național Oak Ridge al Departamentului de Energie, din Statele Unite,
au dezvoltat un algoritm care analizează datele de la drone, camere și senzori pentru a arăta
comportamente neobișnuite ale vehiculelor ce pot indica activități ilicite, inclusiv transport de
materiale nucleare. [»][78]
[Spaţiu »][79]
[Cea mai slabă planetă fotografiată vreodată de pe Pământ, descoperită după mai bine de 10 ani][80]
Astronomii au descoperit o a treia planetă care orbitează în jurul stelei apropiate Beta Pictoris.
Gigantul gazos nou identificat, Beta Pictoris d, este de 100 de ori mai slabă decât prima planetă
cunoscută a sistemului și se numără printre cele mai ușoare exoplanete fotografiate vreodată direct
de pe Pământ. [»][81]
[Ştiinţa şi sănătatea »][82]
[Deteriorarea substanței albe a creierului joacă un rol cheie în bolile neurodegenerative][83]
Până acum, se credea că bolile neurodegenerative, cum ar fi boala Alzheimer și boala Parkinson, erau
asociate în principal cu modificări ale substanței cenușii a creierului. [»][84]
[Un studiu dezvăluie legătura dintre o bacterie intestinală și creșterea forței musculare][85]
Cercetătorii de la Universitatea din Almería, Universitatea din Granada și Centrul Medical
Universitar Leiden au identificat o bacterie intestinală din genul Roseburia asociată cu creșterea
forței musculare și îmbunătățirea condiției fizice. [»][86]
[Dieta »][87]
[O dieta bogată în grăsimi modifică celulele creierului asociate cu pubertatea timpurie][88]
Cercetătorii de la Universitatea Sao Paulo, din Brazilia, au identificat că o dietă bogată în
grăsimi poate accelera pubertatea prin modificarea celulelor creierului asociate cu sistemul
reproducător. [»][89]
[Filme documentare »][90]
[Locurile sacre ale buddhiștilor: Bodhi Gaya, Bihar, India][91]
Călătorii, Documentar.
Bodhi Gaya, cu templul Maha Bodhi și cu lespedea de piatră numită Vajra Asana, marcând locul de sub
copacul Bodhi sub care Buddha a atins Eliberarea, este cel mai sacru dintre toate locurile buddhiste
din lume. [»][92]

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
                                                                                                    
Un zâmbet pe zi                                                                                     
                                                                                                    
Un cetaţean uitandu-se în gradina proprie vede o gorilă intr-un copac. Sună la Asociaţia            
Coborâtorilor de Gorile din Copaci care îi trimite un om dotat cu o bâtă de baseball, o puşcă, o    
pereche de catuşe şi un câine Chihuaua. Cetaţeanul nostru, uimit, îl întreabă ce are de gând sa     
facă.                                                                                               
Omul raspunde: - Eu voi urca în copac, lovesc gorila, ea cade, chihuaua o muşcă de testicole, gorila
îşi va apropria mâinile într-un gest de apărare, iar dumneata îi vei pune cătuşele.                 
- Bine, bine, zice cetaţeanul, dar puşca la ce foloseste?                                           
- In cazul in care cad eu primul din copac, împuşti chihuaua.                                       
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
                                                      
Proverbul zilei                                       
                                                      
Sapă fântâna înainte de a-ți fi sete.                 
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[Vitamine »][93]
[Nivelul scăzut de vitamina E, legat de avorturile spontane][94]
Cercetătorii de la Universitatea Johns Hopkins din Baltimore, în colaborare cu echipele locale din
Bangladesh care studiază sănătatea mamei şi a copilului, au realizat un nou studiu care leagă
nivelurile mai scăzute de vitamina E, de rate mai mari de avort spontan. [»][95]
[Minerale »][96]
[Zincul, bun pentru sănătate][97]
Oamenii de ştiinţă de la Universitatea Wisconsin-Madison au descoperit că un deficit de zinc poate
contribui la boli precum Alzheimer şi Parkinson, boli care au fost legate

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Grain?

Grain is an AI notetaker and conversation intelligence platform that records video calls, Slack
huddles, and in-person meetings to provide accurate summaries, insights, and coaching feedback.
